info.name: CredVault — Team Vault API
info.description:
The Team Vault screen: the Team Details pane (admin card + department cards), one department (stats, level chips, hierarchy tree), View all (organisation), the My Credentials / Team Credentials table, and Export Credentials.

BEFORE YOU START
1. Fill baseUrl, email/password (an employee with Credentials Vault → View), adminEmail/adminPassword (a client admin of the same company), managerEmail/managerPassword (that employee's reporting manager, in the same team).
2. Run 00 · Setup, then 01 · Team Vault in order: later requests read the ids saved by earlier ones.

EXPORT: tab mine (My Credentials) or team (Team Credentials) picks the same rows as the table, then department_id / vault / risk / type / q, and groups[] (the ticked categories). The file carries every table column; passwords need acknowledge + your account password.

Full details: docs/CREDVAULT_VAULTS_API_SHEET.md → Team Vault and Export.

item.name: 01 · Team Vault — departments, hierarchy, team credentials, export
item.description:
The Team Vault screen.

• Left pane: GET /team/departments — the admin card (Vault Admin, members, departments, HODs, level bar) and one card per department (HOD name + initials, members, level bar, team credential counts).
• Department view: GET /team/departments/{id} — stats (members, levels, teams), the level chips (Admin, HOD, TL, Executive, Employee, Intern), members (flat) and tree (Vault Admin → each person under their manager, with children_count and team_size on every node).
• View all: GET /team/organisation — the same for every department, with a department node under the Admin.
• The table: GET /normal-vault/credentials?tab=mine|team&department_id=&member_employee_id=&q=.
